source.arcIDs: Official epic arc _key values of CCP SDE build 3405148 (table epicArcs); every row below names one of them.
source.clientBuild: The client build this server targets is 3396210 (sde/lock.json pinned; eve-logic is the V24.01 client).
source.method: in-client-build: the arc ID is in the V24.01 client constants. newer-than-client: it is not, and other evidence says it is later. unknown: no evidence either way (none in this table).
source.noNames: Arc names and other CCP strings are not in this file.
